Unlicensed (macOS never activates; HYPERWHISPER_ACCOUNT_KEY is absent from this box anyway). Two traps cost this round ~20 min: (1) ~/.codex was root-owned, so every codex exec died with 'in-process app-server client: Permission denied (os error 13)' and fuzz-drive reported 'no JSON from codex' at step 0 -- sudo chown -R user:user ~/.codex. (2) gui-mac.mjs only knew esc/enter/tab, so 'key Escape' TYPED the letter E; a real Escape needs the alias patch. The mac bundle and process are 'HyperWhisper' with capitals -- killall hyperwhisper and pkill -f hyperwhisper.app both no-op.
